name: Matching Different Section Rows by Coordinate Rescaling
definition: For $D=\{00,10,01\}$ on $S=\{s_1,s_2\}$, take $A=D\times\{0,1\}^{\{u\}}$ and $B=D\times\{0,1\}^{\{v\}}$ with distinct private coordinates, and embed their union as $X=D\times\{00,10,01\}$.
properties: The section rows $(1/3,2/3)$ for $A$ and $(2/3,1/3)$ for $B$ both extend at margin $1/5$. Positive coordinate rescalings turn both into the common row $(1/2,1/2)$ at margin $1/10$, after which section gluing gives a certificate of margin $1/120$. The exact margin is $1/3$; the conversion bound is deliberately nonsharp.
